name: Tejas Networks Ltd
title: Tejas Networks Ltd - 540595 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 was a loss-making transition year: revenue ₹1,103 cr and PAT loss ₹909 cr, with inventory ₹2,438 cr and receivables ₹3,258 cr; no numeric guidance, only a 'goal' of PAT-positive FY27.

triggers.label: Inventory ₹2,438 cr vs ₹2,363 cr QoQ
triggers.quote: Inventory at the end of the quarter stood at INR2,438 crores compared to INR2,363 crores in the previous quarter.

triggers.label: Receivables ₹3,258 cr, BSNL collections pending
triggers.quote: we expect the receivables to progressively come down over the next couple of quarters.

triggers.label: No numeric guidance; PAT-positive FY27 is 'the goal'
triggers.quote: Yes, we don't give the financial guidance, but yes, that's the goal.

triggers.label: Order book ₹1,514 cr vs ₹1,019 cr YoY
triggers.quote: We ended with INR1,514 crores at the end of Q4 as opposed to INR1,019 crores at the end of Q4 of FY25.

triggers.label: Investment not cut; intangibles ₹400 cr → ₹960 cr
triggers.quote: we had not cut down on the investments during the year because of our outlook for the future

guidance.value: None; PAT-positive FY27 described as a goal
guidance.quote: Yes, we don't give the financial guidance, but yes, that's the goal.

red_flags.label: Inventory and receivables build; net debt ₹3,531 cr
red_flags.quote: The cash position at the end of the quarter was INR505 crores and a net debt of INR3,531 crores.

red_flags.label: Debt-funded intangibles with FY26 PAT loss ₹909 cr
red_flags.quote: our investment in intangible is debt funded

red_flags.label: CFO resignation and board changes
red_flags.quote: Mr. Sumit Dhingra, our current CFO, has resigned from the services of the company

evasions.quote: we've never given revenue or any other financial number guidance in the past. And so, I think we will stick to that.
For now, I don't think we have any further clarity with respect to the BSNL add-on order.
typically we do not go into specific deal numbers and all
